resources.string: This add-on lets Tiresias use Gemini Nano, the artificial intelligence built into the phone itself (Pixel 9 and later, Galaxy S25 and later and other recent phones). Everything is processed on the phone, without Internet. You do not need to open it: Tiresias uses it when you choose «The phone\'s» in Settings, Artificial intelligence.
Gemini Nano is ready on this phone.
This phone has Gemini Nano; the system will download it the first time it is used.
This phone does not have Gemini Nano (or the bootloader is unlocked).
The system is downloading Gemini Nano. It may take a few minutes…
